about_the_game:
Timokha caught up with the plane on the way to the Maldives and showed his secret weapon! What is it?! Maybe a new kind of pie? No! This is a summons to an exciting journey to serve in the ranks of the Pie Federation! Tough quests with polishing the push and painting the grass green await you! Escape as soon as possible, because mom and dad are waiting for you at the resort! This game is an exciting and funny quest that will definitely cheer you up! You have inventory at your disposal, with which you will interact to solve puzzles. A variety of army challenges await you:
1) Shooting at targets
2) Assembling / disassembling a pie shooter
3) Running over obstacles
4) Washing floors for speed
5) Push-ups and pull-ups
And ... Much more! Along the way, the main villain Timokha will pursue you and interfere with your plans! You will also be met by other hostile soldiers of the pie army! This escape will be unforgettable for you!
